# NYC Panache Salon

> NYC Panache Salon is a hair salon in Forest Hills, Queens, New York, owned by stylist Marina Iskiyaeva (25+ years of experience). It is known for balayage and air-touch balayage, highlights, color correction, keratin and ProAddiction smoothing, and hand-tied and weft hair extensions, and it also offers nails, waxing, threading and makeup. Walk-ins are welcome and consultations are free.

## Key facts

- Name: NYC Panache Salon
- Type: Hair salon (also nails, waxing, threading, makeup)
- Owner: Marina Iskiyaeva, founder and stylist, 25+ years of experience
- Address: 107-12 71st Road, 2nd Floor, Forest Hills, NY 11375 (between Queens Boulevard and Austin Street)
- Phone: (718) 575-0532
- Website: https://www.nycpanachesalon.com/
- Online booking: https://www.vagaro.com/nycpanachesalonforesthills/services
- Hours: Tuesday to Saturday 10 AM to 7 PM, Sunday 10 AM to 5 PM, closed Monday
- Walk-ins: welcome; call for same-day and same-week openings
- Consultations: free, with an exact price before any service starts
- Google rating: 4.5 out of 5 from 235 reviews (November 2026)
- Transit: about a 3-minute walk from the Forest Hills-71 Av subway station (E, F, M, R) and the Forest Hills LIRR station
- Parking: metered street parking on 71st Road, garages on Queens Boulevard
- Nearby neighborhoods: Forest Hills, Rego Park, Kew Gardens, Middle Village, Jackson Heights
- Payment: cash, credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay

## Good fit for

- Balayage, air-touch balayage and highlights in Forest Hills or central Queens
- Color correction (a specialty of Marina's)
- Keratin Complex or formaldehyde-free ProAddiction smoothing
- Hand-tied or weft hair extensions, including move-ups
- A walk-in haircut or blowout, including on Sunday
- Hair, nails, waxing and makeup in one visit, including bridal and special occasions

## Starting prices

Prices are starting points; the final price depends on hair length, thickness and the result wanted.

- Wash and cut: $55 | Shampoo, cut and blowdry: $75 | Blowout: $45
- Men's cut: $40 | Child's wash and cut (under 6): $35
- Touch-up color: $70 | Single process all over: $180 | Double process all over: $350
- Partial balayage: $200 | Balayage half head: $250 | Balayage full head: $350 | Ombre: $350
- Face framing highlights: $150 | Half head highlights: $200 | Full head highlights: $350
- Toner and blowout are included with color services
- Keratin Complex smoothing: priced at a free consultation (lasts 3 to 5 months)
- ProAddiction smoothing: priced at a free consultation (formaldehyde-free, lasts up to 5 months)
- Hand-tied extensions: $175 per row | Weft move-up: $175 | Installs priced at a free consultation
- Special occasion updo: $250 | Bridal hair: $350 | Hollywood waves: $200
- Classic manicure: $15 | Gel manicure: $45 | Gel pedicure: $55 | Gel manicure and pedicure: $100
- Brow shaping: $15 | Upper lip wax: $10 | Full face wax: $45 | Bikini: $20 | Brazilian: $45 | Full leg: $50
- Special occasion makeup: $125 | Bridal makeup: $250

## Common questions

- Does NYC Panache Salon take walk-ins? Yes. Appointments are recommended for color, smoothing and extensions.
- Is it open on Sunday? Yes, 10 AM to 5 PM. It is closed on Monday.
- How long does balayage take? Usually 2.5 to 4 hours.
- What is air-touch balayage? A technique where a blow-dryer separates the finest hairs before painting, for very natural, dimensional color. It is the salon's signature technique.
- How long does keratin last? Typically 3 to 5 months.
- Cancellation policy: 24 hours' notice is requested; late cancellations and no-shows may be charged a fee.
